name: Endless Detour
oracle_text: The owner of target spell, nonland permanent, or card in a graveyard puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library.
blocked_sentences: The owner of target spell, nonland permanent, or card in a graveyard puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library.

needs.what: a single target kind whose pool spans three zones at once -- a spell on the stack, a nonland permanent on the battlefield, or a card in any graveyard -- as one instance of the word "target" (one spec, one choice), with legality re-checked per zone on resolution
needs.why_existing_wont_do: TargetModel.kind offers 'spell_or_permanent' (stack + battlefield only, Sink into Stupor) and 'card_in_graveyard' separately; writing two specs would make the spell target twice and require both to be legal, which is a different card. 'any' is battlefield objects plus players. The effect half already exists: put_on_top with owner_chooses: true asks the owner top-or-bottom and moves the object to its owner's library, so only the target kind is missing
